title: Exact exponential shell-tail majorant
question: For w(x)=2^(-||x||_1) on Z^3, does the ambient edge tail outside l1 radius R equal 3*(4R^2+8R+14)*2^(1-R) and dominate every finite positive-coordinate rectangular-box tail?
method: Count the integer l1 shells directly and verify N_3(0)=1 and N_3(n)=4n^2+2 for n>=1.
Derive and check the exact closed-form tail recurrence T(R)-T(R+1)=3*N_3(R)*2^(-R) and the base T(1)=78 with Fraction arithmetic.
Enumerate all 343 ordered boxes in [2,8]^3, construct every positive-coordinate nearest-neighbour edge and compare each radius 1..12 finite tail to the ambient formula.
Run an independent integer-loop reconstruction, eight hostile scalar/operator/physical mutations, and the integrated verifier.
Compile Lean R444 arithmetic fixtures while keeping the Q3LOCK commutator and history-tail transfer explicitly open.
finding: The primary exact lane passes 4519/4519 assertions and the independent integer-loop lane passes 4505/4505. The shell formula and closed-form recurrence hold exactly; all finite tails from 343 boxes and 4116 radius rows are dominated by T(R). The hostile lane rejects 8/8 mutations and the integrated verifier passes 27/27 with Lean R444 PASS. The aggregate box family has 102900 edges. This is a scalar geometric majorant only.
decision_reason: R-444 supplies a reusable exact exponential shell-tail majorant for the edge-weight model and makes explicit the finite-to-ambient subset step. It does not identify this scalar weight with the actual Q3LOCK commutator/history tail or prove any operator, common-core, exhaustion or physical theorem.
decision_scope: Scalar weights on Z^3 and positive-coordinate finite rectangular nearest-neighbour boxes, with exact radii R=1..12 in the executable [2,8]^3 sweep and arithmetic shell/tail identities.
assumptions: The ambient l1 shell count is N_3(0)=1 and N_3(n)=4n^2+2 for n>=1.
Each lower endpoint has at most three positive-coordinate outgoing edges and finite boxes are subsets of the ambient edge set.
The lower-endpoint weight is nonnegative and equals 2^(-l1 radius).
The finite sweep is a reproducibility check, not a thermodynamic or operator limit.
missing_assumptions: Q3LOCK commutator/history-tail transfer and a representation-independent common core.
Weighted product-domain, source/cutoff/volume/shape-uniform operator or state-weighted estimates.
Exhaustion Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, sector coercivity, physical-empty and continuum inputs.
Any Yang--Mills dynamics or mass-gap theorem.

adversarial_review.check: The origin shell is separate and the formula is used only for R>=1.
Each exact one-shell decrement is checked against the closed form for all tested radii.
Every declared box tail is explicitly compared with the ambient formula; no equality is asserted for finite boxes.
The hostile firewall rejects commutator, history-tail and weighted-operator promotions.
No physical-empty, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap flag is enabled.

boundary: R-444 is T0 claim-nonbearing scalar geometric evidence. It does not close a Q3LOCK commutator or history tail, weighted operator, common core, common alpha, exhaustion, OS/KMS/GNS, physical-empty, C6, Pre-A, Sector-A, Yang--Mills dynamics or a mass gap.
next_action: Use T(R) only as a scalar spatial weight while deriving the missing Q3LOCK-specific commutator/history-tail transfer on a declared common core; retain any mismatch as a route-local obstruction.
no_overclaim: Exact scalar shell arithmetic and finite rectangular dominance do not imply an operator, thermodynamic, physical or Yang--Mills conclusion.
